note: Values transcribed by hand for the journal version, each with the source cited per key; two keys restate, for the prose, the magnitudes of generated keys. The exploratory results among them (the X1a, X2 and X5 values) are those that the rule-assembled manuscript printed as literal text, transcribed from the cited table or sentence of the seed commit 35b7942a (Online Resource 1 file esm/exploratory-x1-x2.tex, formerly sections/supplement-exploratory-x1-x2.tex, whose X5 paragraph is now in esm/exploratory-x3-x7.tex). The tags EX06, EX07, EX09 and EX14 in the per-key sources name rows of the project's claim-evidence map, which is not archived. The X1a and X2 records (x1a.json, x2.json) are outside the released result catalog; the X5 per-cell values are in it, through comparisons.json, but the minimum-maximum ranges over r used here have no keys. Rounding differs by family. X1a: the AUCs are the three-decimal entries of tab:supp-x1a, which round the unrounded record values, and the lag difference is the record value rounded to four decimals. X2: the three-decimal values round the four-decimal entries of tab:supp-x2, which gives the same values as rounding the unrounded means. X5: the ranges are rounded to three decimals from the unrounded per-cell AUCs, as in tab:x5-lags, not from four-decimal values. The j.exposure values are rounded to three decimals from the six-decimal values of their sources.
